steps.tl: Pindutin ang menu sa kaliwang taas para makita ang lahat ng serbisyo ng Barangay.
steps.en: Tap the menu at the top left to see every service of the Barangay.

steps.tl: Piliin ang serbisyong kailangan mo, halimbawa Ambulansya, Appointment o Reklamo.
steps.en: Choose the service you need, for example Ambulance, Appointment or Complaints.

steps.tl: Sa emergency, pindutin ang pulang SOS sa gitna para tumawag agad.
steps.en: In an emergency, tap the red SOS in the middle to call right away.

steps.tl: Sa Account makikita ang profile mo, ang Barangay ID mo, at ang pag-verify ng account.
steps.en: In Account you will find your profile, your Barangay ID, and account verification.

steps.tl: Kung emergency, tumawag muna sa numerong ito para mas mabilis ang sagot.
steps.en: In an emergency, call this number first so you get an answer faster.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-request ng Emergency kung kailangan agad ng ambulansya.
steps.en: Tap Request an Emergency if you need the ambulance right away.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan ng pasyente, ang nangyari, at kung saan siya susunduin.
steps.en: Write the patient's name, what happened, and where to pick them up.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Makikita mo ang status ng request sa MGA REQUEST KO.
steps.en: Tap Send. You can follow the request under MY REQUESTS.

steps.tl: Hindi emergency (halimbawa dialysis o check-up)? Pindutin ang Mag-schedule at pumili ng petsa at oras.
steps.en: Not an emergency (for example dialysis or a check-up)? Tap Schedule and pick a date and time.

steps.tl: Piliin ang serbisyo, halimbawa Barangay Clearance.
steps.en: Choose the service, for example Barangay Clearance.

steps.tl: Pumili ng petsa ng pagkuha. Lunes hanggang Biyernes lang.
steps.en: Pick the date you will pick it up. Monday to Friday only.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-book ang Appointment. Dalhin ang valid ID sa Barangay Hall sa napiling petsa.
steps.en: Tap Book Appointment. Bring a valid ID to the Barangay Hall on that date.

steps.tl: Sa TRACKING makikita mo kung handa na ang dokumento mo.
steps.en: Under TRACKING you can see when your document is ready.

steps.tl: Lalabas dito ang Barangay ID mo kapag verified na ang account mo. May QR code ito na ini-scan ng Barangay.
steps.en: Your Barangay ID shows here once your account is verified. It has a QR code the Barangay can scan.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-print o i-save bilang PDF para may kopya ka.
steps.en: Tap Print or save as PDF to keep a copy.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-file ng reklamo.
steps.en: Tap File a complaint.

steps.tl: Piliin ang uri ng reklamo, halimbawa ingay o alitan.
steps.en: Choose the kind of complaint, for example noise or a dispute.

steps.tl: Ikuwento ang nangyari: kailan, saan, at sino ang kasali.
steps.en: Tell what happened: when, where, and who was involved.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala sa Barangay. Pribado ang reklamo mo.
steps.en: Tap Send to the Barangay. Your complaint is private.

steps.tl: Piliin ang room: Buong Barangay, o ang Purok mo.
steps.en: Pick a room: the whole Barangay, or your own Purok.

steps.tl: I-type ang mensahe mo. Magalang na usapan lang po.
steps.en: Type your message. Please keep it respectful.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Nabubura ang mga mensahe pagkatapos ng 7 araw.
steps.en: Tap Send. Messages are deleted after 7 days.

steps.tl: May tanong o problema sa app? Pindutin ito para sa pribadong chat sa Developer.
steps.en: Have a question or a problem with the app? Tap this for a private chat with the Developer.

steps.tl: Kapag verified ang account mo, may entry code ka na sa raffle. Wala ka nang ibang gagawin.
steps.en: Once your account is verified you get a raffle entry code. There is nothing else to do.

steps.tl: Gusto mong magbigay? Pindutin ang Magdonate o maging sponsor. Tatawagan ka ng Barangay.
steps.en: Want to give? Tap Donate or become a sponsor. The Barangay will call you.

steps.tl: Basahin dito ang buong paliwanag ng raffle.
steps.en: Read the full explanation of the raffle here.

title.tl: Paano bumili at magbenta sa Tindahan
title.en: How to buy and sell in the Shop

steps.tl: Maghanap ng paninda dito, o pumili ng category sa ibaba.
steps.en: Search for items here, or pick a category below.

steps.tl: Gusto mong magbenta? Pindutin ang Magbenta (Libre!).
steps.en: Want to sell? Tap Sell (Free!).

steps.tl: Magdagdag ng larawan ng paninda mo.
steps.en: Add a photo of your item.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan, presyo at maikling paglalarawan.
steps.en: Write the name, the price and a short description.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-post. Susuriin muna ito ng Barangay bago lumabas.
steps.en: Tap Post. The Barangay checks it before it appears.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Hiramin sa gamit na kailangan mo, halimbawa tent o upuan.
steps.en: Tap Borrow on the item you need, for example a tent or chairs.

steps.tl: Piliin ang petsa ng kuha at ng balik.
steps.en: Pick the pick-up date and the return date.

steps.tl: Piliin ang dami ng hihiramin.
steps.en: Choose how many you will borrow.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala ang request. Aaprubahan ito ng mga opisyal.
steps.en: Tap Send request. The officials will approve it.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan mo o ang control number.
steps.en: Type your name or your control number.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-check para makita kung kasama ka sa listahan.
steps.en: Tap Check to see if you are on the list.

steps.tl: Isulat ang buong pangalan mo, ang purok at ang contact number.
steps.en: Write your full name, your purok and your contact number.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang email at password (hindi bababa sa 8 characters).
steps.en: Enter your email and a password (at least 8 characters).

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Gumawa ng Account. Buksan ang email mo at i-click ang link para ma-confirm.
steps.en: Tap Create Account. Open your email and click the link to confirm.

steps.tl: Pwede ring Google ang gamitin kung wala kang gustong tandaang password.
steps.en: You can also use Google if you do not want to remember a password.

steps.tl: Sa Account, pindutin ang Mag-selfie para ma-verify.
steps.en: In Account, tap Take a selfie to verify.

steps.tl: Basahin at lagyan ng check ang pahintulot na gamitin ng Barangay ang selfie mo.
steps.en: Read and tick the permission for the Barangay to use your selfie.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Buksan ang camera at mag-selfie (walang shades o mask). Hintayin ang approval ng Barangay.
steps.en: Tap Open camera and take a selfie (no sunglasses or mask). Wait for the Barangay to approve.

steps.tl: Dito mo mababago ang pangalan, purok, contact number at birthday mo.
steps.en: Here you can change your name, purok, contact number and birthday.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-save ang Profile pagkatapos magpalit.
steps.en: Tap Save Profile after you change something.

steps.tl: Piliin ang wika (TL o EN) at ang laki ng text (Aa) para mas madaling basahin.
steps.en: Choose the language (TL or EN) and the text size (Aa) so it is easier to read.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-logout kapag tapos ka na, lalo na sa hiniram na phone.
steps.en: Tap Log out when you are done, especially on a borrowed phone.

title.en: What to do in an emergency

steps.tl: Gulo, nakawan o aksidente? Pindutin ang TANOD. Tatawag agad ang phone mo.
steps.en: Trouble, theft or an accident? Tap TANOD. Your phone will call right away.

steps.tl: May sakit at kailangan ng doktor? Pindutin ang HEALTH CENTER.
steps.en: Someone is sick and needs a doctor? Tap HEALTH CENTER.

steps.tl: Sunog? Pindutin ang BFP (Bumbero).
steps.en: A fire? Tap BFP (the fire station).

steps.tl: Kailangan ng ambulansya? Pindutin ito para sa request ng ambulansya ng Barangay.
steps.en: Need an ambulance? Tap this to request the Barangay ambulance.

steps.tl: Para sa pambansang emergency, pindutin ang 911.
steps.en: For a national emergency, tap 911.

title.tl: Paano tingnan ang gamot sa Botika
title.en: How to check medicine at the pharmacy

steps.tl: I-type ang pangalan ng gamot na hinahanap mo.
steps.en: Type the name of the medicine you are looking for.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Meron para makita ang gamot na may stock ngayon.
steps.en: Tap In stock to see the medicine available now.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ubos para makita kung ano ang naubos na.
steps.en: Tap Out of stock to see what has run out.

title.en: How to post on the Community Board

steps.tl: Pindutin ang kahon at isulat ang gusto mong i-post sa komunidad.
steps.en: Tap the box and write what you want to share with the community.

steps.tl: Pwede kang magdagdag ng larawan.
steps.en: You can add a photo.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-post. Susuriin muna ng Barangay bago ito lumabas.
steps.en: Tap Post. The Barangay checks it before it appears.

steps.tl: Piliin ang Lahat, Purok ko, o Post ko para makita ang gusto mo.
steps.en: Choose All, My Purok, or My Posts to see what you want.

steps.tl: Pindutin ito para tumunog ang phone kapag may bagong pabatid.
steps.en: Tap this so your phone rings when there is a new announcement.

steps.tl: Para sa akin: ang mga pabatid para sa purok mo at sa buong Barangay.
steps.en: For me: announcements for your purok and the whole Barangay.

steps.tl: Lahat ng purok: makita ang mga pabatid ng ibang purok.
steps.en: All puroks: see the announcements of other puroks.

title.en: How to register for an event

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Magparehistro sa Event.
steps.en: Tap Register for an Event.

steps.tl: Isulat ang buong pangalan, purok at contact number.
steps.en: Write your full name, purok and contact number.

steps.tl: Piliin kung para saan ang pagpaparehistro, halimbawa Ayuda o Clean-up.
steps.en: Choose what you are registering for, for example Aid or Clean-up.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-register para tapusin.
steps.en: Tap Register to finish.

steps.tl: Nawawala ang gamit mo? Tingnan dito kung may nakakita na.
steps.en: Lost something? Check here if someone found it.

steps.tl: Nakakita ka ng gamit ng iba? Tingnan dito ang mga nakita.
steps.en: Found something that belongs to someone else? See the found items here.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-report para ilista ang nawawala o nakita mo, kasama ang larawan.
steps.en: Tap Report to list what you lost or found, with a photo.

steps.tl: Isulat ang mungkahi mo para sa Barangay.
steps.en: Write your suggestion for the Barangay.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Binabasa ito ng mga opisyal.
steps.en: Tap Send. The officials read it.

title.tl: Paano maghanap ng trabaho sa Hiring
title.en: How to find a job in Hiring

steps.tl: Maghanap ng trabaho, halimbawa helper, driver o cashier.
steps.en: Search for a job, for example helper, driver or cashier.

steps.tl: Piliin ang uri ng trabaho: Full-time, Part-time o Pana-panahon.
steps.en: Pick the kind of job: full-time, part-time or seasonal.

steps.tl: Sa Inapply ko makikita ang mga inaplayan mo.
steps.en: Under Applied you can see the jobs you applied for.

steps.tl: May negosyo ka at kailangan ng tao? Pindutin ang Mag-post.
steps.en: Have a business and need workers? Tap Post.

title.en: How to use the Skills Directory

steps.tl: Maghanap ng may skill na kailangan mo, halimbawa tubero.
steps.en: Look for someone with the skill you need, for example a plumber.

steps.tl: May skill ka? Pindutin ang Magpa-lista ng Skill para mahanap ka ng mga kabarangay.
steps.en: Have a skill? Tap List my skill so neighbours can find you.

steps.tl: Maghanap ng lugar sa Malineng, halimbawa tindahan o paaralan.
steps.en: Search for a place in Malineng, for example a shop or a school.

steps.tl: Pumili ng uri ng lugar para makita lang ang mga iyon.
steps.en: Pick a kind of place to see only those.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Nasaan ako para makita ang kinatatayuan mo sa mapa.
steps.en: Tap Where am I to see where you are on the map.

steps.tl: May negosyo o lugar na wala pa rito? Pindutin ang Mag-pin ng lugar.
steps.en: Have a business or a place that is not here yet? Tap Pin a place.

steps.tl: Piliin ang kalagayan ng proyekto: Ginagawa, Nakaplano, Tapos na o Naantala.
steps.en: Pick the status of the project: in progress, planned, done or delayed.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Tapos na para makita ang mga natapos nang proyekto. Sa bawat proyekto makikita ang larawan, badyet at progreso.
steps.en: Tap Done to see the finished projects. Each project shows its photos, budget and progress.

title.tl: Paano tingnan ang Pondo ng Barangay
title.en: How to see the Barangay Fund

steps.tl: Piliin ang taon para makita ang badyet at kung saan napunta ang pondo.
steps.en: Pick the year to see the budget and where the funds went.

steps.tl: Sa Mga gastos makikita kung saan ginastos ang pera ng Barangay.
steps.en: Under Expenses you can see where the Barangay money was spent.

steps.tl: Piliin ang purok at isulat ang address ng bahay ninyo.
steps.en: Pick your purok and write your home address.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Magdagdag ng miyembro para ilista ang bawat kasama sa bahay.
steps.en: Tap Add member to list each person in your household.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-save. Tinutulungan nito ang Barangay sa ayuda at serbisyo.
steps.en: Tap Save. This helps the Barangay with aid and services.
